rules.name: @polaris/no-arbitrary-tailwind
rules.description: Disallow Tailwind arbitrary values; use Polaris token-based classes (e.g. bg-accent-brand-normal, p-4) instead. Layout utilities like grid-cols-[...] are exempt.

rules.name: @polaris/no-deprecated-polaris-token
rules.description: Disallow deprecated Polaris token aliases (rc.0 / v0.6 era); use v0.7 spec tokens instead. Run

rules.name: @polaris/no-direct-font-family
rules.description: Disallow direct font-family declarations; use Polaris font tokens (var(--polaris-font-sans), font-polaris).

rules.name: @polaris/no-hardcoded-color
rules.description: Disallow hardcoded color values; use Polaris design tokens (CSS variables or @polaris/ui token imports).

rules.name: @polaris/no-non-polaris-css-var
rules.description: Disallow consumption of non-Polaris CSS variables. Every

rules.name: @polaris/no-tailwind-default-color
rules.description: Disallow Tailwind built-in color palette utilities (slate-*, rose-*, etc.); use Polaris semantic tokens (label-*, state-*, accent-brand-*) instead.

rules.name: @polaris/prefer-polaris-component
rules.description: Prefer @polaris/ui components over native HTML elements that have a Polaris equivalent (button, input, textarea, select, dialog).
